|showheader = n }} '''Seasonal Decor''' is a piece of [[Furniture]] that changes appearance with each [[Seasons|season]]. It can be placed anywhere in Stardew Valley, indoors or outdoors. Seasonal Decor is sold at [[Pierre]]'s stand at the [[Flower Dance]] for {{Price|350}} and at the Decoration Boat during each night of the [[Night Market]] for {{Price|500}}. It can be won from the Crane Game inside the [[Movie Theater]], during {{season|spring}}. Note that placing Seasonal Decor outside [[The Farm]] in an NPC's path will result in it being destroyed.
